export: WVDOT Crash Database extract (ReportBeam reports), as delivered on an email request to WVDOT Traffic Accident Data
spec: West Virginia Uniform Traffic Crash Report DMV-17-F (ReportBeam sample, https://www.reportbeam.com/reportbeam/pdfs/Report/Samples/WestVirginiaSample.pdf, saved ~/.hermes/state-manuals/wv/, pp. 1-3) and WVDOT 'Accident Records Database Coding and Data Entry Procedures' (NHTSA copy, read via web_extract; it 403s scripted downloads)
layout_seen_live: MMUCC-coded columns in a consultant copy of WVDOT data, https://services2.arcgis.com/jCPZmQjF0kIPAohC/arcgis/rest/services/WV_Pedestrian_Crashes_2019_2023/FeatureServer/0 (checked 2026-11-08). Evidence of layout only, not a source.
unit: one row per crash in the layout seen; vehicle/person tables not seen

map.datetime: C01 Date of Crash ('2019-01-02') + C02 Time of Crash ('12:15:00')
map.lat_lon: C - Latitude / C - Longitude (288 of 297 rows = 97.0% in the consultant copy)
map.county_code: C06 Location Name starts with the county ('Kanawha WV 061/00'); also the first 2 digits of C08
map.road_number: C08 County Based Route ID: CC S RRRR SS PP, zero-padded to 11 digits. CC county, S sign system (1 Interstate, 2 US, 3 WV, 4 County/HARP), RRRR route, SS sub-route, PP supplemental: 20300610000 = Kanawha WV 61; 6200600007 -> 06200600007 = Cabell US 60 (07 suffix, 'West'). Read the numeric C08a, not C08 (text in Excel E-notation '2.03006E+12'). Write routes in OSM ref form ('WV 61', 'US 60', 'I-64'); put them in road_number, not primary_road (Ohio NLFID rule)
map.milepost: C09 Milepost (county milepost on the route; joins to Roads_And_Highways/Publication_LRS)
map.primary_road: form: ROUTE 1 / STREET 1 ('Crash occurred on'); not in the consultant copy, so city-street crashes may come with lat/lon only
map.is_freeway: C05 Sign System = 'Interstate' or form 'If on controlled access highway' (main road / interchange / ramp)
map.severity: C03 Crash Severity: 'Fatal Crash' -> K, 'Serious Injury Crash' -> A; the other values (minor, possible, PDO) aren't in the fatal/serious-only copy: expect MMUCC 'Minor Injury Crash' -> B, 'Possible Injury Crash' -> C, 'Property Damage Only' -> O, else U. Person level: form Injury Classification K/A/B/C
map.collision_type: C14 Manner of Collision ('Single Vehicle Crash' ...)
map.weather: not in the copy; the form has weather
map.location_type: C18 Location of First Harmful Event ('On Roadway')
